privacy.title: How Quizora uses data
privacy.onDevice: Your progress, stars, streak, XP and settings are saved only on this phone. There are no accounts and no servers. Uninstalling the app, or Settings, Reset progress, erases it.
privacy.ads: Quizora is free because it shows ads from Google AdMob. Google and its ad partners may use your advertising ID, approximate location from your IP address, and app activity to show and measure ads. Rewarded videos are always your choice.
privacy.notifications: The optional daily reminder is created on your phone. Nothing is sent to us.
privacy.noAccount: We do not collect your name, email, contacts, photos, microphone or precise location. Quizora is for ages 13 and up.
privacy.choices: Where the law asks for it, Quizora asks for your consent before showing ads, and you can change it any time in Settings, Privacy choices.
